all.skill_withheld: Skill against the base rate is held until every program counted has 30 resolved forecasts, a cluster of linked questions counting once. With fewer, the base rate comes from the same few outcomes, so the figure would mostly show which questions were picked.
all.reference_withheld: Skill against each question's own reference is held until every program counted has 30 resolved forecasts that carry one, a cluster counting once. A reference is the probability a plain rule (a base rate, a market, no change) gave the question when it was registered; forecasts registered before 15 Nov 2026 carry none.
all.note: a declared cluster counts once (each member weighs 1/k); decomposition is approximate within bins; skill_vs_base_rate uses the sample's own base rate and skill_vs_reference each question's own reference, each given only from 30 independent resolved forecasts
